description: Peligrosidad por sismos is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by idem.comunidad.madrid. The Catalogue of Potential Risks of Civil Protection for the Community of Madrid carries out an analysis of the danger and vulnerability by combining them to obtain an assessment of the risks of the Community of Madrid. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Hazard from earthquakes" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Comunidad de Madrid, Peligrosidad, Sismos, IDEM, Protección Civil. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WFS, WMS. The listing shows 2024-01-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.es). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
